title: Synthetic JSON structure check
question: Does the supplied synthetic record conform to the expected JSON shape?
summary: A small illustrative record showing how REA separates artifacts, methods, evidence and findings. It is not a report of a real external experiment.

artifacts.description: Synthetic fixture included with this repository.

evidence.statement: The example record conforms to the bundled investigation schema when checked with the REA Core validator.
limitations: This is an illustrative repository fixture, not an independent validation of an external artifact.

findings.statement: The example demonstrates the expected structure of a version 1 investigation record.
findings.validation_notes: The example is synthetic and exists to exercise the schema and CLI.

limitations: The schema validator checks structure only. It does not establish that a described method was run or that a finding is true.
